title: feat(rho12): rho still fails reverse on B12 and stays much rounder than nu
science: One of the strongest results in this slice: a structural DECOUPLING of roundness from reversal. The equal-weight rule rho (cost 3 iff equal inward weight or seed-exit) has var(|v|_2/t)=0.000948 on B_12(0), seven times smaller than nu's 0.006661 -- far closer to Euclidean isotropy -- yet it FAILS the diamond reverse (1728 < 3136) and the doubled pair (6912 < 16384). Carries the exact identity t_rho
